_comment: Paste these values into Cline / Roo Code / Zoo Code settings -> API Provider: OpenAI Compatible. Base URL is the Modelis gateway (https://modelishub.com/v1). modelis-auto is the standard tier, same as modelis-auto:standard ($0.04/call within 8k in / 2k out). Other tiers: modelis-auto:basic ($0.008, 4k in / 1k out) and modelis-auto:premium ($0.10, 4k in / 1k out). Usage above those limits is billed per token.
